script: Why does no one like Bronny? See even though his dad is LeBron James, people talk like he snuck into the league. Every box score becomes a meme the second it hits Twitter. Every time he checks in, fans pull phones out praying for a mistake. One bad airball loops for a week, but a tough steal or big three vanishes overnight. Coaches see a rookie guard learning defense and spacing, while the crowd sees just his last name. The question isn't if Bronny belongs in the NBA, it's how long he can survive being LeBron's son.
